倘若你一只手，或是一只脚，
叫你跌倒，就砍下来丢掉。你缺一只手，
或是一只脚，进入永生，
强如有两手两脚被丢在永火里。
If your hand or your foot causes you to stumble
cut it off
and cast it from you. It is better for you to enter into life maimed or crippled
rather than having two hands or two feet to be cast into the eternal fire.

If your hand or your foot causes you to stumble
cut it off
and cast it from you. It is better for you to enter into life maimed or crippled
rather than having two hands or two feet to be cast into the eternal fire.
And if your hand or your foot is a cause of trouble
let it be cut off and put it away from you: it is better for you to go into life with the loss of a hand or a foot than
having two hands or two feet
to go into the eternal fire.
